newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
Vessels: Karyatis loading 28,000 tonnes using big bags. Ailsa loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, eight vessels to load using big bags.
Road: 126 trucks arrived carrying sugar on May 28 and 29.

Vessels: Araya loading 35,200 tonnes bulk sugar, Qing Jiang loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar, Unisea loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Waiting to dock, Diana P, Fulvia and Cormorant each to load 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar.
Stocks: Around 37,500 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
